svg.font-family: Inter,'Noto Sans SC','Source Han Sans SC','Microsoft YaHei','PingFang SC','Hiragino Sans GB',Segoe UI,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif
svg.text: Build your station from one-metre blocks
Snap together floors, walls and ceilings, then shape space with half-walls, wedges and finishes.
1 Each face takes its own finish
Top is floor, sides are walls, bottom is ceiling.
2 Lay them joined into whole floors
Neighbouring blocks merge; no stray walls at the seams.
3 Floors and walls can each have colours
Enamel panels take any tint — give the station its own style.
Half-walls and wedges free up corners and edges.
Track beds and soil aren't walkable — pave routes with passable floors.
